request.description:
Cancel an assistant action

Discards an action the assistant proposed.

Needs a session, or an API key or OAuth token with the `ai:use` scope.

Confirm an assistant action

Runs an action the assistant proposed. Not offered over MCP, so an agent cannot approve its own actions.

Needs a session, or an API key or OAuth token with the `ai:use` scope.

Create an email template

Saves a reusable email template. Variables in double braces are filled from the booking.

Needs a user session; API keys and OAuth tokens are refused.

Add a habit or task

Adds a recurring habit or deadline task with a priority. A higher priority may move a lower one; nothing moves a booking.

Needs a session, or an API key or OAuth token with the `ai:use` scope.

Decide an exception

Allows the time once (booking it outside normal availability) or declines it.

Needs a user session; API keys and OAuth tokens are refused.

Delete a conversation

Removes an assistant conversation.

Needs a session, or an API key or OAuth token with the `ai:use` scope.

Delete an email template

Deletes one of the caller's email templates.

Needs a user session; API keys and OAuth tokens are refused.

Delete a habit or task

Removes a habit or task.

Needs a session, or an API key or OAuth token with the `ai:use` scope.

Discard a follow-up

Drops a follow-up draft without sending it.

Needs a user session; API keys and OAuth tokens are refused.

Draft a template with AI

Writes a template subject and body from a short description of what the email is for.

Needs a user session; API keys and OAuth tokens are refused.

Get assistant domain

Returns the organization's own email domain for the assistant, if any, and whether its MX record is verified.

Needs a user session; API keys and OAuth tokens are refused.

Get assistant settings

Returns the caller's scheduling assistant name, follow-up nudges, all-party agreement, SMS phone, follow-up drafts and the address people copy in.

Needs a user session; API keys and OAuth tokens are refused.

Get a conversation

Returns one assistant conversation with messages and pending actions.

Needs a session, or an API key or OAuth token with the `ai:use` scope.

Get email agent settings

Returns the caller's email agent address and status.

Needs a user session; API keys and OAuth tokens are refused.

Get assistant preferences

Returns the windows the user prefers for meetings and focus.

Needs a session, or an API key or OAuth token with the `ai:use` scope.

Get time suggestions

Scores free times against preferences and workload, for up to 31 days.

Needs a session, or an API key or OAuth token with the `ai:use` scope.

Get voice agent settings

Returns voice booking settings.

Needs a user session; API keys and OAuth tokens are refused.

Get workload analysis

Analyzes a week's meeting load and fragmentation against the previous week.

Needs a session, or an API key or OAuth token with the `ai:use` scope.

List conversations

Lists the caller's assistant conversations.

Needs a session, or an API key or OAuth token with the `ai:use` scope.
